packet.comment: The player picked an option of a choice in the scene they're watching. The server records the option's branch for the stories that wait on it.
A map cue of the scene is due: the server takes the player to its map and tile. Only a map cue of the scene playing, once.
The scene has ended, or the player skipped it. The server counts it as seen, lifts its lock, and plays whatever waits on it.
